title: handoff
description: Payload of the ONE `handoff` artifact fs_handoff writes (/fs-handoff). Every session artifact is referenced BY PATH with {path, type, id, sha256} pinning the file's bytes; no artifact payload is ever copied. `notes` and `next_steps` arrive already redacted and `redactions` counts what was removed (kinds with count 0 are omitted).

artifacts.description: one row per artifact JSON path from the session, reference only — the payload stays in its own file

path.description: path of the artifact JSON file, exactly as the caller gave it: the handoff carries the path, never the payload

type.description: the envelope's artifact type (e.g. probe_report, data_report, launch_record)

id.description: the envelope's artifact id (the file's stem when the envelope holds no id)

sha256.description: sha256 of the artifact FILE's bytes, pinning what was handed off

notes.description: free text for the next session, already redacted of secrets and PII

next_steps.description: what the next session should do first, each entry redacted exactly like `notes`

redactions.description: kind -> count of redactions applied (kinds with count 0 are omitted): secrets env_value, sk_token, ghp_token, akia_key, bearer_token and PII email, phone, credit_card, ssn, national_id

additionalProperties.description: how many occurrences of that kind were replaced with [REDACTED:<kind>]
